notablePrerequisites:
Triclopean Sight attached to Sanctum Weaver.
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three enchantments.
description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gatherer of Graces by sacrificing Triclopean Sight.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling Triclopean Sight from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gatherer of Graces ability, regenerating it.
Cast Triclopean Sight from exile by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Sanctum Weaver.
Triclopean Sight enters the battlefield, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.
